```blitzbasic
TCPStreamPort:Int32 tcp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tcp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The port on the other end of a TCP stream.
